fee_notes: $20,000 per outlet (first and each subsequent). Plus $10,000 Initial Training Fee for first outlet only. Area Development Fee = $20,000 x number of additional outlets, credited toward Initial Franchise Fee upon opening.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee for the first and each subsequent Outlet you open is $20,000 and is due and payable in full to us when you sign the Franchise Agreement.
